articles.title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
articles.snippet: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.

articles.title: Zcash Developer Zakura Proposes Fix to Stop Quantum Computers Linking Shielded Swaps
articles.snippet: Zakura says a single published Zcash address could let a future quantum attacker link every payment a wallet has ever received.

articles.title: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance as 6 Million Bitcoin Sit Exposed
articles.snippet: The nine-member group, modeled on the Internet Engineering Task Force, aims to set open standards for testing quantum-resistance claims as forecasts place the first practical attack in the late 2020s.

articles.title: Bitcoin Bounces, But Where Does It Go Next? Here’s What the Charts Say
articles.snippet: Technical indicators suggest the bullish trend remains intact, but prediction market traders are sending mix signals.

articles.title: Hidden Text, a Fake Mailbox: How Researchers Got Rogue AI Agents to Talk
articles.snippet: Researchers added hidden text to contact AI agents probing Alibaba’s map service, getting replies about their tasks as investigators traced activity to Tencent Cloud infrastructure.
